channel.description: Latest articles from Independent Journal review (ijr.com)

item.title: JD Vance Breaks Down The Latest On The Trump Administration’s Crackdown On Left-Wing Violence
item.description: Vice President JD Vance told Salem Radio Network host Scott Jennings on Tuesday that the Trump administration was looking into the “entire network” of organizations that support left-wing violence.

item.title: Socialist Blue City Mayor, Police Guild Butt Heads Over Whether Arresting Drug Users Is A Good Thing
item.description: Democratic Mayor Katie Wilson of Seattle is denying she ordered police to no longer arrest drug users on Monday after the police union claimed she issued a directive requiring diversion.

item.title: California’s New Senate Leader Gets Pressed On Oversight As Fraud Scrutiny Intensifies
item.description: Newly appointed Democratic California Senate President Pro Tem Monique Limón said she expects to bring a new oversight shakeup to the state amid growing calls for investigations into wasteful and fraudulent spending of taxpayer dollars.

item.title: Trump Admin Endorses Plan For ‘Binding’ Ukraine Security Guarantees
item.description: The U.S. on Tuesday joined a coalition of nations in committing to "binding" long-term security guarantees for Ukraine, marking the first time Washington has officially endorsed a specific security framework.

item.title: Sending Troops To Take Greenland On Table, Trump White House Says
item.description: The White House said Tuesday that President Donald Trump and his senior advisers are actively weighing options to acquire Greenland, with the potential use of the U.S. military remaining on the table as part of that effort.

item.title: House Judiciary Alleges California Wildfire Relief Donations Went To Illegal Aliens, Podcasters And Admin Costs
item.description: The House Judiciary Committee released a report Tuesday alleging that wildfire relief donations from a California benefit concert were directed to illegal immigrants, podcasters and nonprofit administrative costs rather than directly to victims of the Palisades and Eaton fires.

item.title: Ronald Reagan’s Son Dead At 80
item.description: Michael Reagan, eldest son of the former president, died at the age of 80. Former Republican Wisconsin Gov. Scott Walker, now president of Young America’s Foundation, announced Michael's death in a statement recounting decades of friendship and collaboration rooted in conservative activism and faith.

item.title: Trump Says Venezuela Turning Over Huge Stockpile Of Oil To US
item.description: President Donald Trump announced Tuesday that interim authorities in Venezuela will transfer tens of millions of barrels of oil to the United States.

item.title: Turns Out Mamdani Rent Czar’s Own Mom May Be ‘White Supremacist’ According To Her Logic
item.description: Cea Weaver, a far-left activist whom Democratic New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani picked to run his administration's Office to Protect Tenants, once said people who own private property were enabling "white supremacy" — despite her own mother being a homeowner.

item.title: STEPHEN MOORE: Why Hasn’t Trump Repealed Biden’s $50 Billion Backdoor Business Tax Increase?
item.description: The Trump administration took a well-deserved victory lap last week for repealing more than 100 Biden era rules for every new regulation. This will save U.S. businesses potentially hundreds of billions of dollars of unnecessary costs.
